label: admission_example_luna
note: Worked example: GPT-6 Luna at low and medium against Claude Haiku 5.5 at low (the house seat model), both on json_mode (production's mode for both since 2026-10-14). Sources are evidence/evaluation/model_admission/report.md (report) and its experiment_log.md (log). Cases: the fourteen ten-seat test turns (the slices every ten-seat admission run used, n 5 = 70 samples an arm, log §3) and the 16 vote cases 'as played' of the Haiku effort replay (n 10, as in gameplay/deduction/experiment_log.md §2; the vote_closing_now slice repeats 2f19d908 day 3 with a later closing line and is left out). Votes are right by the true roles, except 2f19d908 day 3, where the log defines right from the evidence: the two unclaimed players or an abstain (gameplay/deduction log §2). Integration: a mode must pass every probe call; no real turn may fail (DeepSeek V4 Pro passed 27 of 27 probes and failed 3 of 6 real turns, report §2 finding 2); a mode must reason when thinking is asked for (a forced tool call turned thinking off silently, finding 1). max_bad_rate_gap 6: two runs of Haiku low on the same 14 turns (70 samples each) scored 10% and 16% (report §1, 'two runs of one model differ by about 6 points'), so a smaller gap cannot be told from a rerun. worse_p_threshold 0.05: the conventional level; the clear results in the report sit below it (Haiku low 8/0, p 0.008; Luna low 8/1, p 0.039). max_vote_gap 10: no rerun spread was measured for votes; at 160 votes near a 50% rate one arm's rate has a binomial spread of about 4 points, so the gap between two arms about 5.6, and 10 points is about two of those; Haiku low against medium differed by 20 points (65 against 98 of 160). max_p95_seconds 30: the live game gives a request 30 seconds before it goes to the rescue model (report §3-4). No token ceiling: cost is read from the report's table, not gated. quality_rejects false: while the project is experimental a model is dropped only for cost, latency or integration (owner 2026-10-24); quality and vote results are reported as advisory. max_vote_gap is provisional: derived, not measured. Judge: Claude Sonnet 5.5 for the hand-written expectations, as in the vote replay; it is from neither model under test but from the reference's family (report §1 caveat). Speed (provisional, frontend/docs/stage_fit/README.md, 2026-10-24): the stage plays each beat at its full hold and the server must keep ahead of it. Discussion set: median at or under 5.5 s and slowest 5% at or under 11 s, i.e. no slower than Claude Haiku 5.5, whose stage waits 2.7-5.1% of the time (mostly after passes, which show for 4 s; a median at or under 4 s would keep up through passes). Vote set: slowest 5% at or under 11 s (ballots are written in parallel and rarely make the stage wait). The shared criteria.speed keeps only the 30 s request budget as the slowest-5% ceiling for any other set.
